correctness.rationale: Both directions of the two classifications were rederived from the defining Egyptian-fraction equations. Geometric-sum bounds force the smaller prime to be 2; exact algebra then forces q=2^a+1 on the pseudoperfect side and b=1, q=2^a-1 on the Giuga side. Exact rational checks on 37,260 bounded tuples produced zero mismatches.

originality.rationale: Machacek's 2018 full text, current OEIS A283423/A286497, exact and synonymous searches, related later Sondow-number work, and the SCOPE archive were checked. The known Fermat/Mersenne families and Machacek's sufficient constructions are explicitly excluded from novelty; no support-two converse or equivalent complete classification was located. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result closes the smallest nontrivial prime-support case completely, proves Machacek's sufficient Fermat/Mersenne constructions are exhaustive there, identifies a sharp exponent asymmetry, and shows the converse to the A073935 inclusion holds on support size two.
